issues.description: Console warning: container element lacks a non-static position (relative/fixed/absolute), causing incorrect scroll offset calculation. This is a layout/positioning warning that could affect scroll-dependent components.
issues.root_cause: The outermost container div in apps/web/app/auth/page.tsx (or its layout) likely uses default static positioning. A scroll-offset utility or component (possibly a custom scrollable area or third-party component) requires the container to have position: relative, fixed, or absolute.

issues.description: Fast Refresh RSC fetch failure for http://localhost:3000/ during hot reload. This is a dev-environment transient error, not a production bug, but indicates the root route may have an issue or the dev server had a momentary disruption.
issues.root_cause: Transient network/server issue during Fast Refresh cycle. Not directly caused by auth page code. Could be root layout or root page.tsx temporarily unavailable during rebuild.

fixes.reason: Adding 'relative' positioning to the outermost container resolves the console warning about non-static position required for correct scroll offset calculation.
